title: anemone multifida var. lanigera
intro: Anemone multifida var. lanigera, commonly known as Anemone lanigera, is a perennial plant species in the family Ranunculaceae. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic activities, as well as its potential to reduce fever and alleviate pain. The therapeutic actions of Anemone lanigera include its ability to calm the nervous system, promote relaxation, and reduce anxiety, making it a popular herb in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
